simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לֹעַ (H3930) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: לֹעַ (lôaʻ) means the gullet First listed occurrence: Prov 23 2.

definitions.full: H3930. loa [ לֹעַ ] noun [masculine] probably throat > (external) (compare Late Hebrew לוֺעַ jaw, cheek , Aramaic לוֺעָא , id. ); — בְּלֹעֶ֑ךָ שַׂכִּין וְשַׂמְתָּ֫ Prov 23:2 and thou shalt put a knife to thy throat (figurative for restraining oneself from indulgence in food).
